question.html:
This question is about relativistic length, time, and velocity transformations.

a State the first postulate of special relativity. [2]

b An automated probe is sent from Earth to the star Sirius, which is at a distance of as measured by an observer on Earth. The probe travels at a constant speed of . Calculate the distance between Earth and Sirius according to a computer on board the probe. [2]

c Two scout ships, A and B, leave a space station at the same time, traveling in opposite directions. Each ship has a speed of relative to the space station. Calculate the speed of ship B relative to ship A using Galilean relativity. [1]

d Identify the postulate of special relativity that is violated by the result in part (c) and explain why this result is impossible in relativistic mechanics. [2]

e Calculate the actual speed of ship B relative to ship A using the relativistic velocity addition formula. [2]

f A beacon on ship B emits a pulse of light every according to its own internal clock. Calculate the time interval between these pulses as measured by an observer on ship A. [2]
